name: robots/maskor__webots_ros2_spot
title: Webots ROS 2 Spot simulation
intro: Webots ROS 2 Spot simulation, adapted from maskor/webots_ros2_spot. It reads `joint_positions`, `odom_position`, `odom_orientation` and `odom_twist`; runs `publish_velocity`, `stand_up`, `sit_down`, `lie_down` and 1 more. `publish_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist to the upstream /cmd_vel subscription; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
